body:
## Problem

- A person building a workflow email picks a person property from the merge-tag menu; the menu inserts `{{person.properties["name"]}}`, so the double quotes come from us, not the user.
- In an HTML attribute like a link `href`, a double quote ends the attribute and mangles the tag. This produced a paying-customer support ticket, with a Liquid parse error (`expected "|" before filter`).
- The quieter variant is worse: when the quotes reach the renderer entity-encoded, the decoder in `nodejs/src/cdp/utils/liquid.ts` does not decode `"`, so the tag resolves to an empty string and the email sends a blank value with no error.

<!-- posthog-self-driving-origin:01a051b0-aa0b-730f-99de-c425a4262599 -->
## Origin

- Conversations: [ticket](https://us.posthog.com/project/2/support/tickets/01a05168-f4aa-0000-e2c4-79a53bbd10d4)
- First signal: 2026-08-30
- Inbox report: [open](https://us.posthog.com/project/2/inbox/reports/01a051b0-aa0b-730f-99de-c425a4262599)
- Likely cause: [`953d50a`](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/commit/953d50a038a4a45be1a4a99d26e39994135e12a8)
- Task started by: a person, from the inbox
<!-- /posthog-self-driving-origin:01a051b0-aa0b-730f-99de-c425a4262599 -->

## Changes

- Merge tags inserted from the menu now read `{{person.properties.name}}` for identifier-safe names and `{{person.properties['name']}}` for everything else. A person pasting one into a link no longer breaks the link or sends a blank value.
- The mechanism: a new `buildPersonPropertyMergeValue` helper emits dot notation for bare identifiers and single-quoted brackets otherwise, matching `buildDelayExpression` in the workflows delay step. Single quotes are safe inside a double-quoted HTML attribute, so the failure mode goes away.

## How did you test this code?

Automated only; the local quill workspace was not built, so the editor UI could not be rendered.

- `emailTemplaterLogic.test.ts` — added a `buildPersonPropertyMergeValue` case matrix: a bare identifier stays dot-access; a leading-`$` name, a name with a space, a dotted name, and a name with an apostrophe each go through single-quoted, escaped brackets. This catches a regression that re-introduces double quotes or fails to bracket a non-identifier name — the exact fault in the report.
- Suite passes locally. `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend fix` applied. Typecheck reports no errors in the changed files; the unrelated `@posthog/quill` module-resolution errors are pre-existing in this environment.

## Automatic notifications

- [ ] Publish to changelog?

## Docs update

None.

## 🤖 Agent context

**Autonomy:** Fully autonomous

Authored by Claude Code (Opus 4.8) from an inbox report on the workflow email merge-tag menu. Skills invoked: `/writing-tests`, `/simplify`, `/writing-simplified-technical-english`.

- Scope: the fix is on the emit side, where we control the tag. The report also notes a decoder gap in `liquid.ts` (`"`/`%22` not decoded); that is left alone, since single quotes never reach the renderer entity-encoded from a double-quoted attribute, so the observed symptom is fixed at the source.
- Considered reusing `buildDelayExpression` from `products/workflows` stepDelayLogic, but importing it pulls a kea logic module (connected to `workflowLogic`) into `frontend/src`, and the frontend rules forbid importing across `products/*`. A small pure helper with a pointer comment to the sibling was the cleaner tradeoff.
- Independent of the emit path; targets the menu's inserted tag directly.

title: fix(messaging): stop merge tags inserting double quotes
